runtime_secret_state_inventory.boundary: live per-object injected leaf source stays inside the ORAM layer as a fixed-size tape plus cursor, consumes leaves sequentially without reallocating, and zeroizes the remaining injected leaf choices on drop

runtime_secret_state_inventory.boundary: the smaller shared kernel runtime now owns the boxed fixed-size slot file, confidential-argument staging, live slot-word accounting, and wipe-on-drop semantics through a Lean-generated slot-support module plus the private RuntimeKernelSlotCall adapter, while uo-core only provides the generated slot-program interpreter and exact-size hash-part buffer; uo-evm reaches that state only through RuntimeKernelMachine and no longer exposes a uo-core slot-state wrapper or call executor surface
runtime_secret_state_inventory.name: ConfidentialKernelSlotState

runtime_secret_state_inventory.boundary: shared per-call outcome bundle; construction is pinned to state.rs and shell.rs through an explicit constructor, the shared uo-core finalization path is the only production consumer of its theorem-packaging API, and engine.rs does not unpack it directly
runtime_secret_state_inventory.name: RuntimeCallOutcome

runtime_secret_state_inventory.boundary: live confidential statements are recorded by the runtime effect adapter, carried through the shared ExecutionTrace/RuntimeCallOutcome bridge, and rechecked against the fixed confidential slot program by both the pre-witness finish-slot bundle and the direct trusted-kernel slot bundle before proof export
runtime_secret_state_inventory.name: ConfidentialStatementTraceBridge

runtime_secret_state_inventory.boundary: shared post-call handoff bundle capturing the after-call hidden witness snapshot plus RuntimeCallOutcome before final execution-trace packaging
runtime_secret_state_inventory.name: TracedRuntimeCallOutcome

runtime_secret_state_inventory.boundary: shared final traced-call handoff bundle carrying one RuntimeCallOutcome plus one boxed hidden before/after ORAM witness carrier into theorem finalization
runtime_secret_state_inventory.name: FinalizedRuntimeCallTraceParts

runtime_secret_state_inventory.boundary: shared pre-call handoff token carrying the hidden committed-state snapshot without exposing the raw snapshot type outside the traced-call bridge
runtime_secret_state_inventory.name: TracedRuntimeCallStart

runtime_secret_state_inventory.boundary: runtime/theorem finalized hidden-witness bundle projecting before/after ORAM witness state through boxed fixed-size buffers without exposing raw snapshot helpers, and wiping those hidden witness buffers on drop
runtime_secret_state_inventory.name: TracedRuntimeCallWitnessState

runtime_secret_state_inventory.boundary: the hidden Path-ORAM position-map witness now stores its leaf array in a boxed fixed-size buffer rather than a growable vector, and the theorem-side validator keeps those leaves boxed rather than reopening them into temporary Vec state, so the proof-facing runtime witness path preserves that public-bounded shape all the way into exported theorem artifacts
runtime_secret_state_inventory.name: RuntimePathOramPositionMapWitness

runtime_secret_state_inventory.boundary: secret-bearing committed/shadow object maps stay inside crate::runtime, with distinct public and confidential shadow wrappers delimiting the shell boundary, a boxed fixed-order object table, and exact-size boxed builders instead of growable transient entry vectors on the confidential path
runtime_secret_state_inventory.name: RuntimeShadowState / ConfidentialRuntimeShadowState / PublicRuntimeShadowState / CommittedRuntimeState

runtime_secret_state_inventory.boundary: shared hidden ORAM witness snapshot wrapper built only from state.rs through the shared exact-size CommittedRuntimeWitnessSnapshotBuilder, stored in boxed fixed-size buffers for the public-bounded ORAM witness set, used only to assemble traced-call start/outcome/witness handoff bundles, and wiping those hidden witness buffers on drop
runtime_secret_state_inventory.name: CommittedRuntimeWitnessSnapshot

runtime_secret_state_inventory.boundary: the recursive runtime value representation now keeps both struct fields and array elements in boxed fixed-size buffers rather than growable Vec carriers, and it now exposes an exact-size boxed canonical-byte helper so secret-bearing aggregate values do not reopen a generic growable container before sealing when they flow through the runtime/object layer
runtime_secret_state_inventory.name: Value

runtime_secret_state_inventory.boundary: object-level confidential state is non-Clone, helper-restricted, and all secret-bearing ciphertext slots in the runtime object graph now use fixed boxed buffers, including the raw-backend map entry slot; the full-scan array/small-map bootstrap seal path and the small-map record plaintext helper now also stay on exact-size boxed buffers rather than growable Vec<u8> carriers, and UO array reads/writes now compute the logical result through masked full-slot scans rather than direct secret-indexed value access
runtime_secret_state_inventory.name: RuntimeObject graph

runtime_secret_state_inventory.boundary: live ORAM logical state remains inside runtime with restricted helper use, a boxed fixed-shape entry array, a fixed-capacity stash whose allocate/reset/insert path now routes through Lean-generated helpers, boxed public page arrays, a boxed fixed counter slot, a boxed fixed-capacity position map, fixed-shape bucket block buffers, and exact-size metadata-page scratch on both the surrogate and Path-ORAM sides; surrogate directory pages decode directly into caller-owned entry buffers, Path-ORAM position-map/stash pages are filled through exact-size slices rather than growable plaintext page vectors, and the live Path-ORAM position map now stays boxed across decode and rewrite instead of widening into a temporary Vec<Option<usize>> on the confidential path
runtime_secret_state_inventory.name: OramState

runtime_secret_state_inventory.boundary: direct seal/open stays in codec; the deterministic nonzero transport helpers live in a Lean-generated codec fragment, the exact-size plaintext staging and wipe-on-drop shell now live in the Lean-generated surface fragment, and the handwritten codec shell is reduced to key lifecycle plus public delegating methods; the fixed-size raw/UO slot stores keep their ciphertext cells in boxed buffers via Lean-generated raw-slot allocation and copy-and-wipe helpers while the UO bootstrap/write path is forced through Lean-generated boxed-filler and seal-into helpers and records only public update-shape write evidence rather than cloning ciphertext snapshots
runtime_secret_state_inventory.name: StoreCipher and plaintext staging
